content.text: A **formal language** is fixed by its syntax: exact rules for which strings of symbols count as formulas.

content.definition: A string that follows the syntax rules. Whether it is true is a separate question.

examples.title: Well formed
examples.note: Each follows the rules for building formulas.

examples.title: Not well formed
examples.note: These break the rules, so they are not formulas at all.

question.prompt: What makes a formula well formed?
options: It follows the syntax rules of the language
question.hint: Is it about truth, or about form?
question.explanation: A well formed formula follows the grammar of the formal language. Its truth is a separate matter.
